Xiph Tremor (lowmem branch) — integer Vorbis decoder with bundled Ogg framing.

Source: https://gitlab.xiph.org/xiph/tremor  (branch lowmem)
Commit: 89a7534bf2e70112e0354452b17a78675ca92dbf (2019-08-22)
License: BSD-3-Clause, see COPYING (Copyright (c) 2002, Xiph.org Foundation)

The files here are that commit's, with two changes so that every compiler
audiodsp is built with takes them:

- os_types.h: the branch for GCC on Windows read Cygwin's <_G_config.h>,
  which MinGW doesn't have, and now takes its integer types from <stdint.h>;
- codebook.c, _book_unquantize's case 3: arithmetic on a void pointer (a GNU
  extension MSVC refuses) is done on a char pointer, which is the same
  address.

The example program and the autotools build are left out. Nothing in this directory is compiled on its
own: src/shared/audiodsp_vorbis.c includes the .c files into one translation
unit, renames every external symbol to audiodsp_tremor_*, and routes the
allocator, so a firmware that links a second copy of Tremor still links.
